main.script: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What is SpeedTree?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"SpeedTree is the industry-standard toolkit for vegetation creation. The toolkit consists of a modeler, tree library, and Runtime SDK."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Does SpeedTree work with Unity?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes, SpeedTree's integration with the Unity Editor allows for a smooth workflow featuring the one-draw-call, straight-to-Unity export, and the all-new SpeedTree lightweight wind."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is SpeedTree only for Unity users?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"No, SpeedTree comes with a highly flexible workflow that allows you to export your work to the real-time engine or DCC of your choice. No engine-specific modeler or license is needed."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I try SpeedTree for free?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"A free, limited-export, 30 day trial can be started after downloading the SpeedTree Modeler. If you are a studio or business making > 1 million a year, please contact us at sales@speedtree.com for a full evaluation."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What features can I expect when I start using the modeler?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"This tool offers artist-focused procedural modeling. It’s paired with nondestructive manual editing for fine tuning to match a concept. It contains powerful photogrammetry tools for building off and texturing from a custom mesh. Multiple wind animation for games including shader based & vertex color. Vfx Growth & wind point cache animations Dynamic LOD generation Extensive export system (atlases, billboards, .st, .st9 .cgf, .stsdk, .fbx, obj, .usd ., .xml, .abc) Leaf cutout system for building complex canopies Generators for tree details like knots, peeling bark or two-toned bark."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is the latest version of SpeedTree and what is new?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"SpeedTree 10 modeler is the latest version and includes: Physics-based vines: A new generator with drooping and hanging capabilities equipped for a broad range of uses. Trim: A screen space tool for cutting and pruning the tree. Spine: A way to rig meshes from DCC applications in order to set them with SpeedTree spines. This allows you to bend and animate a mesh while setting it with bones and location information."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I learn SpeedTree?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Find the answers to your technical questions in our documentation. Follow expert tutorials and interactive livestreams on the SpeedTree YouTube channel. Joinn the community on SpeedTree Discussions"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"I have seen a lot of realistic trees made with SpeedTree, but is it possible to make stylized vegetation?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"You can use SpeedTree to bring any environment – stylized or realistic – to life. Start with production-ready assets from the SpeedTree Library with editable texture styles or bring in your own unique maps. Curious to see stylized vegetation made with SpeedTree? Watch our sizzle reel."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Do export options differ depending on which SpeedTree license I have?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"SpeedTree offers both games and cinema pipelines. We support .OBJ, .FBX, .USD, .ST, .STSDK, .CGF, .XML complete with games ready textures, atlas & LOD. Static Mesh, Point Cache, .OBJ, .FBX, .ABC, .USD, .XML For more details, please review our documentation."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"I have an older version of Speedtree, can we upgrade?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes, please contact us at sales@speedtree.com For indie and pro users, the latest version is available in the Unity Dashboard."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I run SpeedTree on two computers?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes, but you’ll need to sign out of one device before using it on another."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I use a floating license?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"RLM and floating licenses are available on request for Enterprise users. Please reach licensing@speedtree.com with your purchase order to request."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I acknowledge SpeedTree in my Game or accolade?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"If you licensed a project with SpeedTree prior to our acquisition by Unity in July 2021, please accompany the logo with the text line: \"© 2002 IDV Inc, 2021 Unity Technologies\" For all projects licensed after July 2021, please accompany the logo with the text line: \"© [insert current year] Unity Technologies\" Example: \"© 2026 Unity Technologies\""}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I sell the trees I create?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"SpeedTree Terms of Service does not allow for the resale or redistribution of trees."}}]}

div.p: SpeedTree is the industry-standard vegetation toolkit for projects of any size and style, used in both games and film. Create and customize vegetation models with procedural generators and manual art tools in the SpeedTree Modeler.

a.class: mango:group/btn mango:relative mango:flex mango:w-fit mango:items-center mango:justify-center mango:gap-2 mango:whitespace-nowrap mango:rounded-full mango:cursor-pointer mango:font-sans mango:text-sm mango:leading-4 mango:font-semibold mango:tracking-[-0.01rem] mango:box-border mango:py-0 mango:no-underline mango:transition-[box-shadow,background-color,color,border-color,scale] mango:duration-300 mango:data-[pressed]:scale-95 mango:data-[disabled]:cursor-not-allowed mango:data-[disabled]:opacity-40 mango:outline-hidden mango:data-[focus-visible]:before:pointer-events-none mango:data-[focus-visible]:before:absolute mango:data-[focus-visible]:before:box-border mango:data-[focus-visible]:before:-inset-1 mango:data-[focus-visible]:before:z-10 mango:data-[focus-visible]:before:rounded-full mango:data-[focus-visible]:before:border-2 mango:data-[focus-visible]:before:border-blue-focus mango:data-[focus-visible]:before:content-[''] mango:border-0 mango:bg-blue-500 mango:text-white mango:btn-primary-shadow-default mango:data-[hovered]:bg-blue-600 mango:data-[pressed]:bg-blue-700 mango:data-[pressed]:btn-primary-shadow-pressed mango:h-12.5 mango:pl-9 mango:pr-8

div.p: Build out your environments with production-ready assets that suit your production style, timeframe, and budget. Our Games and Cinema libraries contain adaptable asset files that randomize, adjust seasons and are set with wind animations with a full set of 8k resolution PBR textures.

The Runtime SDK supports all major platforms, including PC, console, mobile, and VR.

div.p: Yes, SpeedTree's integration with the Unity Editor allows for a smooth workflow featuring the one-draw-call, straight-to-Unity export, and the all-new SpeedTree lightweight wind.

button.span: What features can I expect when I start using the modeler?

div.class: mango:h-(--disclosure-panel-height) mango:overflow-clip mango:transition-[height] mango:duration-500 mango:ease-standard mango:motion-reduce:transition-none
mango:prose mango:text-body-base mango:max-w-4xl mango:pb-5 mango:text-balance mango:text-gray-900 mango:[--mango-prose-leading:1.625rem] mango:dark:text-white mango:prose-headings
div.p: This tool offers artist-focused procedural modeling. It’s paired with nondestructive manual editing for fine tuning to match a concept. It contains powerful photogrammetry tools for building off and texturing from a custom mesh.

ul.li: Multiple wind animation for games including shader based & vertex color.
Vfx Growth & wind point cache animations
Leaf cutout system for building complex canopies
Generators for tree details like knots, peeling bark or two-toned bark.

button.span: What is the latest version of SpeedTree and what is new?

div.class: mango:h-(--disclosure-panel-height) mango:overflow-clip mango:transition-[height] mango:duration-500 mango:ease-standard mango:motion-reduce:transition-none
mango:prose mango:text-body-base mango:max-w-4xl mango:pb-5 mango:text-balance mango:text-gray-900 mango:[--mango-prose-leading:1.625rem] mango:dark:text-white mango:prose-headings
div.p: SpeedTree 10 modeler is the latest version and includes:

ul.li: Physics-based vines: A new generator with drooping and hanging capabilities equipped for a broad range of uses.
Trim: A screen space tool for cutting and pruning the tree.
Spine: A way to rig meshes from DCC applications in order to set them with SpeedTree spines. This allows you to bend and animate a mesh while setting it with bones and location information.

div.p: You can use SpeedTree to bring any environment – stylized or realistic – to life. Start with production-ready assets from the SpeedTree Library with editable texture styles or bring in your own unique maps. Curious to see stylized vegetation made with SpeedTree? Watch our sizzle reel.

div.p: SpeedTree offers both games and cinema pipelines.
We support .OBJ, .FBX, .USD, .ST, .STSDK, .CGF, .XML complete with games ready textures, atlas & LOD.
For more details, please review our documentation.

82:T139b,{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What is SpeedTree?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"SpeedTree is the industry-standard toolkit for vegetation creation. The toolkit consists of a modeler, tree library, and Runtime SDK."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Does SpeedTree work with Unity?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes, SpeedTree's integration with the Unity Editor allows for a smooth workflow featuring the one-draw-call, straight-to-Unity export, and the all-new SpeedTree lightweight wind."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is SpeedTree only for Unity users?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"No, SpeedTree comes with a highly flexible workflow that allows you to export your work to the real-time engine or DCC of your choice. No engine-specific modeler or license is needed."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I try SpeedTree for free?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"A free, limited-export, 30 day trial can be started after downloading the SpeedTree Modeler. If you are a studio or business making > 1 million a year, please contact us at sales@speedtree.com for a full evaluation."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What features can I expect when I start using the modeler?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"This tool offers artist-focused procedural modeling. It’s paired with nondestructive manual editing for fine tuning to match a concept. It contains powerful photogrammetry tools for building off and texturing from a custom mesh. Multiple wind animation for games including shader based & vertex color. Vfx Growth & wind point cache animations Dynamic LOD generation Extensive export system (atlases, billboards, .st, .st9 .cgf, .stsdk, .fbx, obj, .usd ., .xml, .abc) Leaf cutout system for building complex canopies Generators for tree details like knots, peeling bark or two-toned bark."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is the latest version of SpeedTree and what is new?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"SpeedTree 10 modeler is the latest version and includes: Physics-based vines: A new generator with drooping and hanging capabilities equipped for a broad range of uses. Trim: A screen space tool for cutting and pruning the tree. Spine: A way to rig meshes from DCC applications in order to set them with SpeedTree spines. This allows you to bend and animate a mesh while setting it with bones and location information."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I learn SpeedTree?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Find the answers to your technical questions in our documentation. Follow expert tutorials and interactive livestreams on the SpeedTree YouTube channel. Joinn the community on SpeedTree Discussions"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"I have seen a lot of realistic trees made with SpeedTree, but is it possible to make stylized vegetation?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"You can use SpeedTree to bring any environment – stylized or realistic – to life. Start with production-ready assets from the SpeedTree Library with editable texture styles or bring in your own unique maps. Curious to see stylized vegetation made with SpeedTree? Watch our sizzle reel."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Do export options differ depending on which SpeedTree license I have?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"SpeedTree offers both games and cinema pipelines. We support .OBJ, .FBX, .USD, .ST, .STSDK, .CGF, .XML complete with games ready textures, atlas & LOD. Static Mesh, Point Cache, .OBJ, .FBX, .ABC, .USD, .XML For more details, please review our documentation."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"I have an older version of Speedtree, can we upgrade?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes, please contact us at sales@speedtree.com For indie and pro users, the latest version is available in the Unity Dashboard."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I run SpeedTree on two computers?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes, but you’ll need to sign out of one device before using it on another."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I use a floating license?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"RLM and floating licenses are available on request for Enterprise users. Please reach licensing@speedtree.com with your purchase order to request."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I acknowledge SpeedTree in my Game or accolade?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"If you licensed a project with SpeedTree prior to our acquisition by Unity in July 2021, please accompany the logo with the text line: \"© 2002 IDV Inc, 2021 Unity Technologies\" For all projects licensed after July 2021, please accompany the logo with the text line: \"© [insert current year] Unity Technologies\" Example: \"© 2026 Unity Technologies\""}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I sell the trees I create?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"SpeedTree Terms of Service does not allow for the resale or redistribution of trees."}}]}a:[null,["$","script",null,{"id":"faq-json-ld","type":"application/ld+json","data-sentry-component":"FaqJsonLdEmitter","data-sentry-source-file":"FaqJsonLdEmitter.tsx","children":"$82"}],"$L83"]
